701.text: his wife , which bulked before the world as an event of just as much magnitude as the loss

quotes.text:
"And to think I was not there
to soothe her last moments!"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"I can't abear to
think as I'm to be parted from you all, miss,"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"I've lost the best missus as ever was, and I shouldn't mind
going after her. Whenever any one gets a good friend in this world,
they're the first to be took away,"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "we must try to be a comfort to poor papa!"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "Let me know when dinner is ready,"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"and if Miss Marjoribanks wants a fire, let it be lighted
in the drawing-room."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"Them men would eat and drink if we was all in
our graves,"
quotes.speaker: Unknown
